card.status: flat plate measured, bump not conclusive
card.entry: flat plate on a 5-grid ladder and bump-in-channel on 3, against the published CFL3D values: flat-plate Cd 0.002864 vs 0.002853 at matched grid size, bump Cd 0.003567 vs 0.003607. The two halves do not stand equally: the bump ladder is not conclusive, its observed order is 0.54 and the pressure component is non-monotone, so the bump number is a comparison and not a converged result; NACA 0012 airfoil next
